_comment: Field heroes in combat (issue #10). Looks come from data/recruits.json; this file is how they fight. short: name on the HUD. hp, speed (px/s), damage (full-power swing), power_rate (gauge refill per second), reach (px), arc (degrees either side of facing). ai: how they behave when you are not controlling them (styles in scripts/hero.gd AI_STYLES; issue #9 adds player-picked presets later). heal: a passive poultice that patches the most hurt ally in range every few seconds, controlled or not.

steady.name: Steady
steady.desc: Waits for a full gauge, then strikes. Backs off while it refills.

guard.name: Bodyguard
guard.desc: Sticks to the leader and only fights what gets close to them.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Charges anything in sight and swings early. Hits often, gets hit often.

healer.name: Hangs back
healer.desc: Keeps her distance, fights only what reaches the leader, patches people up.

ash.special: Unwritten: the Blank hesitates. Ash always leads the party.

bran.special: Big, slow, hard to kill. Clause four: guard the client.

gristle.special: Poultice: every 6 s she patches the most hurt ally nearby for 7 HP. Billing follows.

ninefingers.special: Longest reach in the party, on a narrow line. Aim the point.
